#en: The pattern encoded in the drift around this point is not a destination, but a decision; the lane math splits in two clean branches, each ending at a different cluster of anomalies Vector has been quietly feeding with his tests.  \nDecoding it turns every half-whispered story from technicians and captains into coordinates instead of campfire talk, leaving you with a stark choice between chasing the bureaucrats who buried the first reports or the settlers and haulers who have been living with his experiments at the edge of mapped space.
zh: 编码在这处漂移中的图案不是一个目的地，而是一个决定；航道数学分岔成两支干净的枝干，各自终止于"向量"一直用测试悄然喂养的不同异常簇。\n解码它，便把技术员和船长们每一段半带低语的故事从篝火闲谈变成坐标，摆在你面前的是一个赤裸的选择：去追那些掩埋了最初报告的官僚，还是去追那些一直与他在制图空间边缘的实验共处的定居者和运货船员。

#en: The mech's drifting telemetry burns away in a brief, silent flare, and with it goes the last excuse that these scattered anomalies were just leftover war junk.  \nStripped of that relay, the remaining data points line up in an uncomfortable way: a quietly corrected foreclosure on a nowhere farm, a scratched dataslate buried in dust, a survey node whispering the same offset coordinates, all suggesting that someone patient has been testing how far they can bend both battles and balance sheets without anyone realizing the pattern is theirs.
zh: 机甲的漂流遥测在一道短暂无声的闪光中烧尽，随之而去的还有最后一个借口——这些零散异常只是战争遗留的废料。\n剥去那座中继站后，剩余的数据点在一种令人不适的方式下对齐：一座无名农场上被悄然修正的止赎、一块埋在尘土里被划花的数据板、一个低声重复着同样偏移坐标的勘测节点，全都暗示有一个耐心的人一直在试探能否把战斗与资产负债表都掰弯，而没人意识到这图案出自他手。

#en: Buried in the outpost's dim core, the archive lays out early simulations like a confession whispered to the void, mapping which stations bend first, which routes fracture cleanly, which colonies can be pushed to the edge without quite falling.  \nMatched against the first stray log from that lonely surface site and the unnaturally complete cache drifting in dead orbit, these seed calculations turn scattered accidents into a rough blueprint, hinting that someone has been rehearsing collapse on a scale far larger than any single ring or ship.
zh: 埋在哨站昏暗的核心中，这份档案铺陈出早期模拟，像对着虚空低声吐露的忏悔，标出哪些空间站会最先弯折、哪些航线会干净地断裂、哪些殖民地能被推到边缘而不至于坠落。\n与来自那座孤独地表站点的第一份散落日志、以及死寂轨道中漂流的、异常完整的藏匿点比对，这些初始计算把零散的事故变成一份粗略蓝图，暗示有人一直在演练崩溃，其规模远超任何单一圆环或飞船。

#en: Test runs in the tower show the same chemical signature appearing on opposite sides of the system within minutes, tagged to shipments that never physically moved.  \nBuried in those reports is a repeated route reference that matches the doctored foreclosure reversal on the Freestar world, the misaligned traffic records near the orbital beacon, and the self-contradicting manifests from the abandoned SysDef hull, all pointing toward one corridor where someone has been quietly rehearsing how to move lives on paper faster than any ship can fly.
zh: 塔内的测试运行显示，同样的化学特征在几分钟内出现在星系两端，却标注在从未实际移动过的货物上。\n埋在这些报告里的是一处反复出现的航路引用，它与自由星系联盟世界被动手脚的止赎撤销、轨道信标附近错位的交通记录，以及从被弃联殖防务船体上取下、自相矛盾的舱单吻合，全都指向同一条走廊——有人一直在那里悄悄演练如何让生命在纸面上移动得比任何飞船都快。

#en: Someone etched the same two words you pulled from crowded terminals and whispered bar talk into the side of a rusting grain silo, then repeated them in the approach telemetry burned across the landing pad.  \nGrey Orchard Vector is not a phrase settlers would invent; it is a heading, a name, and a destination folded into one.  \nSeeing it here, on a farm that should have been anonymous, ties together the dead dataslate in the black, the scrambled orbital records, and every survivor who swore their careful pilot knew this place would never last.
zh: 有人把你从拥挤终端与低声酒吧闲谈中挖出的那两个词刻在一座生锈谷仓的侧面，随后又在横贯着陆平台的接近遥测中重复了它们。\n"灰果园向量"不是定居者会编造出的说法；它是一个航向、一个名字与一个目的地折叠成的整体。\n在一座本应无名的农场上看到它，把黑暗中那块死数据板、混乱的轨道记录，以及每一个发誓他们那位谨慎的飞行员早知道这地方撑不了多久的幸存者，串在了一起。

#en: The timing matrix tucked in that research module looks harmless at first glance, just another logistics draft abandoned when funding dried up, but every recurrence date lines up with unexplained supply spikes and missing manifests from other files.  \nFollowed back through the half scrubbed records and the trail matches what I heard in the queues and from that nervous caseworker in New Atlantis a pattern of quiet approvals, diverted shipments, and erased coordinates, all suggesting someone has been feeding an unseen settlement on a fixed, patient rhythm.
zh: 塞在那台研究模块里的时序矩阵乍看无害，不过是又一份因资金枯竭而被弃置的物流草案，但它每一个重现日期都与无法解释的补给尖峰、以及来自其他文件的缺失舱单对齐。\n穿过那些半被擦净的记录回溯，这条线索与我在队列中、从新亚特兰蒂斯城那位紧张个案员口中听到的东西吻合——一幅安静的审批、改道的货运与被抹除坐标构成的图案，全都暗示有人一直以固定、耐心的节奏喂养一座看不见的定居点。

#en: When the chart finishes compiling inside the factory's core, the lines it draws are not trade routes but scars, looping again and again through the same dead corridors and anchoring on a point the nav software insists does not exist.  \nStacked beside the stray dataslate from that forgotten rock, the corrupted ping logs from the silent relay, and the doctored beacon records taken from the abandoned garrison, the pattern stops looking like coincidence and starts reading like a deliberate hand guiding traffic toward a single, carefully hidden gathering of wrecks.
zh: 当星图在工厂核心内部编译完成时，它画出的线条不是贸易航线，而是伤疤，一遍遍地绕着同样的死走廊循环，锚定在导航软件坚称不存在的一个点上。\n与来自那块被遗忘岩石的散落数据板、来自沉默中继站的损坏脉冲日志，以及从被弃驻军取走的伪造信标记录叠放在一起，这图案不再像巧合，而开始读起来像一只刻意的手，把交通引向一处被精心藏匿的残骸聚集地。

#en: When the core finally ruptures, its signal dies with a strangled flicker that ripples across local space, peeling back one layer of misdirection; in the static that follows, a buried return route lights up, pointing toward a debris-choked corridor that no chart admits still exists.  \nIt matches the coordinates hinted at in the first corrupted dataslate, the altered ping from the abandoned relay, and the doctored logs taken off that mercenary ruin, tightening the pattern around a single engineer who has been rearranging wrecks into a map only he was meant to read.
zh: 当核心终于爆裂时，它的信号随着一阵被扼住般的闪烁消亡，涟漪般扫过本地空间，剥去一层误导；在随之而来的静电中，一条被掩埋的返程路线亮起，指向一条任何星图都不承认其仍然存在的、堆满残骸的走廊。\n它与第一块损坏数据板中暗示的坐标、来自被弃中继站被篡改的脉冲，以及从那处佣兵废墟取下的被动手脚的日志吻合，把图案收紧到一个工程师身上——他一直在把残骸重新排列成一张只有他才该读懂的地图。

#en:
The vector traces from the deep-orbit grid stitch perfectly into the last known course of the drifting Navy hulk, turning a nameless wreck into a deliberate waypoint rather than random debris.  
Buried within that ship's sealed logs and stripped corridors is where the path ahead will finally sharpen.  

So far the chase has moved from a forgotten cache on a backwater rock, to nervous whispers in a station dive, to an old relay bunker whose scans did not match the official story, and now to a silent warship everyone nearby pretends never passed through their sky.
zh:
来自深轨网格的向量痕迹完美地缝入那具漂流海军船体最后已知的航程，把一具无名的残骸变成一个刻意的航点，而非随机的碎片。
前路将在那艘船被封存的日志与被拆空的走廊里最终变得清晰。

截至目前，这场追查已从一块穷乡岩石上一处被遗忘的藏匿点，走到空间站酒馆里紧张的低语，再走到一座扫描结果与官方说法不符的旧中继碉堡，如今又来到一艘沉默的军舰——附近所有人都假装它从未经过他们的天空。

#en: When the ledger burns out, it does more than erase a lie; its encrypted failsafe kicks a last, panicked transmission into the dark, pinging a forgotten archive node that was never supposed to light up again.  \nCross-referencing the echo with the stray dataslate from that backwater pit and the mismatched logs scavenged at the dead relay, the investigation shifts from vague suspicions of doctored history to a single, concealed records cache sitting just off a well-traveled lane, exactly where a debris engineer with a grudge would hide the first real draft of the war.
zh: 当账册烧毁时，它抹去的不只是一个谎言；它加密的失效保护把最后一段惊慌的传输踢入黑暗，脉冲唤醒一个本不该再度亮起的被遗忘档案节点。\n把这道回声与来自那处穷乡深坑的散落数据板、以及从死中继站捡回的对不上日志交叉比对，调查便从对篡改历史的模糊怀疑，转向一座紧邻繁忙航道的隐蔽记录藏匿点——正是某个心怀怨恨的残骸工程师会藏起这场战争第一份真实草稿的地方。

#en: The readings preserved in the sample are wrong in a very particular way, a faint shudder in the numbers that never should have appeared this close to a settled lane; only someone chasing that flaw across the systems would leave the same signature behind.  \nOnce matched against the redacted incident logs from the sealed lab and the frantic equations recovered from a discarded slate, the pattern turns from coincidence into a trail, hinting that the same unseen hand has been nudging drives toward the edge of stability wherever the data quietly disappears from the record.
zh: 样本中保存的读数错得非常特殊，是数字里一阵本不该出现在离定居航道如此之近处的微弱颤抖；只有追着这个瑕疵跑遍各星系的人，才会留下同样的特征。\n一旦与来自密封实验室被涂黑的事故日志、以及从被丢弃石板中找回的狂热方程比对，图案便从巧合变成一条踪迹，暗示同一只看不见的手在数据悄然从记录中消失的每一处，都把引擎轻推向稳定性的边缘。

#en: Hidden among routine berth records and "lost" docking slips, a handful of ships appear again and again, always waved through early, always bound for the same quiet stretch of space. Neon's ground crews cannot agree on the details, each retelling of the story shifting slightly as if fear is editing their memories, but the tail numbers do not lie. Follow those privileged hulls, and the trail stops being rumor and starts being a route, leading outward from a dead slate in the black toward whoever is rich enough and ruthless enough to bend whole ports around their passing.
zh: 藏在例行泊位记录与"遗失"的停靠单之间，几艘船一再出现，总是被提前放行，总是驶向同一片安静空域。霓虹城的地面人员对细节各执一词，每一次复述都略有偏移，仿佛恐惧在编辑他们的记忆，但尾号不会说谎。顺着那些享有特权的船体追下去，线索便不再是传言，而开始成为一条路线，从黑暗中一块死石板向外延伸，通向某个富有且冷酷到能让整个港口为它的过境让路的人。

#en: When the sample is finally wired into the forgotten relay, its signature ripples through the old arrays like a remembered voice, waking filters nobody has touched in years.  \nFor a moment the station's dead consoles sketch a phantom lane across the stars, aligning stray pings from that first backwater stop with corrupted timings from the quiet lab and the miscounted traffic that bled through this relay before it was officially shut down, all hinting that her route does not follow the published jump chains at all, but runs just outside them where no one bothers to watch.
zh: 当样本终于接上那座被遗忘的中继站时，它的特征像一道被记起的声音般在老阵列间荡漾，唤醒多年无人触碰的滤波器。\n有那么一瞬间，空间站死去的控制台在星空中勾出一条幽灵航道，把来自第一处穷乡停靠点的散落脉冲、来自安静实验室的损坏时序，以及这座中继站在被正式关闭前漏过的错误计数交通对齐，全都暗示她的路线根本不遵循公布的跃迁链，而是紧贴着它们外侧、无人费心看守之处运行。

#en: The vials were never meant to leave a lab, yet here they sit in a courier's locker, labelled with coordinates that mirror a forgotten listening post and a field garden no registry admits exists.  \nWhoever bankrolled Rourke's experiments smuggled the recipe into Trade Authority traffic, trusting routine to hide intent.  \nNow the trail reads clear enough: the altered wildlife at that lonely homestead, the crooked beacon in high orbit, then the derelict tower's stolen cultures, all pointing toward one last, carefully shielded site where theory is already becoming landscape.
zh: 这些药瓶本不该离开实验室，可它们却躺在一名信使的储物柜里，标签上的坐标映照着一座被遗忘的监听站和一处没有任何登记档案承认存在的田野花园。\n无论是谁资助了鲁尔克的实验，都把配方走私进了贸易管理局的货运里，指望例行公事能掩盖意图。\n如今线索已足够清晰：那座孤独农场聚落里被改造的野生动物、高轨道上歪斜的信标，再到废弃塔中失窃的培养物，全都指向最后一处被精心遮蔽的地点——理论在那里已经变成了地貌。
